## About
Performance Auto Care is an auto repair shop on Jacksboro Hwy in Fort Worth. Owner Cecil Forshee opened the shop and still runs it, and he knows his way around both classic cars and modern ones. Troy Smith is our ASE tech, and he also rebuilds old classic cars.
We work on all major car brands, from brakes to timing belts, air-conditioning repair and rebuilt engine installs. If your car needs something we don't do, like transmission, alignment or muffler work, we deal with reputable shops that do and help keep you running down the road.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 49 reviews. Call, email or drop by and we'll be glad to answer your questions.

## Services
- Bumper to bumper inspection: We check your car from front to back, tell you about any upcoming problems and give you an estimate on the repairs needed.
- Brakes & Ft End Work
- Timing belts and chains: Timing belt and timing chain replacement.
- Computer-aided engine diagnostics: We use computer diagnostics to track down engine problems.
- Air-conditioning service & repair
- Heater cores and rebuilt engines: Heater core work and installation of rebuilt engines.
- Tune ups, struts and shocks: Tune ups, struts, shocks and much more.

## FAQ
Q: Do you honor extended warranty programs?
A: Generally yes. Give us a call with your extended warranty program and we'll let you know.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday.
